Rework cJSON_Utils object compare functions to use an O(N) algorithm on sorted lists. It's a bit of a shame to use the sorts, because cJSON is otherwise incredibly stable (json->cJSON->json is unmodified modulo formatting), but it means we get usable performance, rather than O(N^2) which will make CPUs cry.
